verify_reasons: Escort counts vary by highway type (two-lane vs multi-lane divided); the matrix encodes the stricter of the two configurations — confirm exact escort setup per route with KYTC.

Kentucky publishes no numeric superload/gross-weight threshold; gross is null (case-by-case bridge analysis, $500 fee when required). The commonly cited 200,000 lb figure is third-party, not in KYTC/601 KAR rules.

Single-trip fee $120 per current 601 KAR 1:018 (post-2024 SB 107) conflicts with a stale $60 on the DRIVE FAQ — confirm at issuance. Extended-Weight Coal Haul decal fees and axle schedule (KRS 177.9771) are portal-gated and not captured here.

superload_thresholds.note: Kentucky publishes no numeric superload/gross-weight threshold. A $500 superload bridge-analysis fee applies when required (601 KAR 1:018 sec.3(10)); loads over 15'6" high require a proposed-route survey (Form TC 95-625, sec.6(4)). Annual permits are capped at 16' width. The frequently cited 200,000 lb superload figure is third-party and not in KYTC rules.

width.note: 2-lane: 1 front + 1 rear escort; multi-lane divided: 1 rear escort only (DRIVE Escort Requirements)
over 16' wide: 2 front + 2 rear escorts on all highway types

height.note: over 14'11": 1 front escort with height pole
over 15'6": mandatory proposed-route survey (Form TC 95-625) plus front height-pole escort

length.note: 2-lane: 1 front escort (multi-lane divided: no length escort until 110')
multi-lane: 1 rear escort; 2-lane: 1 front + 1 rear escort
over 120': 1 front + 2 rear escorts on all highway types

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip OS/OW permit = $120 (601 KAR 1:018 sec.3(1), current post-2024 SB 107; the $60 on the DRIVE FAQ is the stale statutory base). Metal-commodities single-trip = $200. Superload bridge analysis +$500 when required. Kentucky does not use a per-mile overweight permit formula. Separate KYU weight-distance tax ($0.0285/mile, vehicles >=60,000 lbs combined weight, filed quarterly) is not part of the permit fee.
single_trip.note: Single-trip = 1 move, valid 10 days. A financial-institution (card/EFT) surcharge applies on top.

annual.note: Annual (601 KAR 1:018 sec.3): non-divisible <14' $750; 14'-16' $1,500; metal $1,250; non-div steel statewide $1,000; feed $300; manufactured home $1,500; riverport $500. Annual permits capped at 16' width.

movement_restrictions: General OS/OW travel allowed 24/7 unless the permit specifies otherwise
Mobile/manufactured homes: daylight only, Mon-Sat; no Sunday travel
Rush-hour ban (all permit loads) weekdays 7-9 a.m. and 4-6 p.m. in Boone, Campbell, Fayette, Jefferson, and Kenton counties
Loads over 12' wide may not move during an NWS wind advisory or adverse weather/road conditions
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 13'6" (car haulers 14'), gross 80,000 lbs; single semitrailer 53' on Interstates/designated hwys, 65' combination on state-maintained non-Interstate hwys.
Permit axle limits: steering 20,000; tandem dual 48,000; tridem 60,000; permit combo max 5-axle 96,000 / 6-axle 120,000 / 7-axle 160,000 lbs; minimum declared GVW for any OW permit = 80,000 lbs.

Escort matrix (DRIVE Escort Requirements) and single-trip fee (601 KAR 1:018) sourced from official KYTC/legislature pages. Extended-Weight Coal Haul decals governed by KRS 177.9771 (portal-gated, schedule not captured).
State-level rules only — county/city permits, bridge-specific engineering and low-clearance routing are out of scope.
